crossRefs.note: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a…
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They…
“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh…
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those…
For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred…
They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

translations.web: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
translations.bsb: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
translations.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
translations.asv: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
